title: Dashboard link sits after Reports and is the first screen after login
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  3. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  4. You are in one location (workplace); write down its name.
  5. That location has one invoice created this month (for example 1.00 hour at $100.00). Write down its subtotal (for example $100.00).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • For 5: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Entry Fleet); then Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = a technician (for example Tech ShopView), Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). The subtotal is on the Finance tab.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the top navigation bar and read the entries from left to right.
  2. Click "Dashboard" in the top navigation.
  3. Read the location name at the top right (beside your initials) and the Revenue tile's headline.
  4. Click the arrow icon beside the word "Revenue" on the Revenue tile (it opens the Sales report on the same range) and read the report's total for that workplace.
  5. Sign out (profile icon at the top right > Logout).
  6. Sign in again as the same user.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The top navigation shows a "Dashboard" entry.
  • "Dashboard" sits immediately to the right of "Reports" (with the build's bar: Work Orders, Schedule, Customers, Parts, Reports, Dashboard).
  • Clicking "Dashboard" opens the dashboard screen with its six tiles.
  • The figures are for the workplace shown in the top bar: the Revenue headline (This Month) is not $0.00, it includes the invoice you created (e.g. $100.00), and it equals the Sales report's total for the same workplace and range.
  • After signing in again, the first screen you land on is the dashboard (not Work Orders).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (Story 1, Dashboard Access and Entry Point); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 1. Design canvas board 01_Opens_After (row 1) for the top bar labels.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The user sees a "Dashboard" entry in the top navigation.”
  • S1-R5: “The "Dashboard" entry sits immediately to the right of the "Reports" entry.”
  • S1-R2: “When the user selects "Dashboard", the dashboard screen opens.”
  • S1-R4: “The dashboard shows figures for the workplace the user currently has selected in the top navigation.”
  • S1-R3: “When a user who has the Reports permission logs in, the dashboard is the screen they land on.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
